purpose_context: Phase 4a delivered the visual vocabulary, primitives, and a browsable gallery. This mission finishes Phase 4 by adding the configurable controls and reusable compositions that later screens compose from, wiring the production shell to use them, and extending the gallery demo scene so every control and composition can be seen and judged by eye. No MIDI or audio is involved.
purpose_tldr: Build the reusable controls and compositions the real screens get assembled from, and a demo scene that shows them all.
